question.question_text: After the camera wearer picks up a box in the kitchen, _________ happens before washing hands.

answer_options.text: Placing various kitchen items in cabinets and drawers
Aligning ice cube trays in the freezer
Disposing of a bottle in the trash

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer picks up a box from the table and walks towards the kitchen. They then open and close cabinet doors, place a jar in a cabinet, and put an ice cube tray in the fridge. The camera wearer also opens and closes cabinet doors multiple times, places a plastic container on the sink, picks it up, picks up a pan from the cooker, and places it on the sink. They walk around the kitchen, open the fridge, pick up and place a bag on the bed, then pick up a pillow from the bed and place it on the floor. The exact sequence of actions after picking up the box is not fully clear.
